facts: Official data.sec.gov APIs require no authentication or API keys.
Submissions API exposes public filing history and is updated in real time as filings are disseminated, typically with processing delay under one second.
EDGAR complete-submission headers expose ACCEPTANCE-DATETIME with acceptance date and EST acceptance time.
limitations: SEC states there is no timestamp indicating when filing content is first available on sec.gov; acceptance time must not be misrepresented as exact first-public-availability time.

facts: Official IPE open dataset contains periodic/eventual company documents including Fato Relevante and groups files by delivery year.
Current and prior-year files are updated weekly; history extends to 2003.
limitations: Dataset publication cadence is weekly and the dataset page does not itself establish an exact public dissemination timestamp suitable for intraday event-time PIT.
